title: A Tajik Bank Shuts Side Door for Russian Cardholders
author: Kulobiddin Norov
text:
Credit: Shutterstock
Tajikistan’s Humo Bank has warned its Russian clients that their cards will be blocked on October 1 unless they visit one of its offices in Tajikistan by September 30 to undergo biometric identification. “If you can’t come to Tajikistan in person and complete the identification, unfortunately, your card will be closed,” the bank told Russian news site Lenta.ru, advising clients to move their remaining balances to ruble cards before the deadline.The bank cited the need to protect clients from fraud. A Russian client, however, told the Telegram channel Ostorozhno Novosti that the bank’s support staff explained it had decided to restrict services for “certain categories of non-resident individuals” whose cards were opened online. She said a transfer of about 300 euros had been stuck for a week and that the bank had stopped responding to her complaints. Humo offered her a new card if she traveled to Tajikistan, valid only for the duration of her legal stay and for no longer than a year.[...]
